svg.title: Coupeville Red Lipstick Special series schematic
svg.desc: Conventional schematic of the series pickup chain. Ground enters the neck module; each module has a single-pole enable switch that either inserts the pickup or joins the module input to its output; neck and middle have a cross-wired DPDT phase switch; the bridge module has none. The bridge output is the bus feeding the volume pot, the tone pot with its 22 nF capacitor, and the output jack.

g.text: COUPEVILLE RED LIPSTICK SPECIAL • SERIES SCHEMATIC
SHOWN WITH EVERY LEVER UP: ALL PICKUPS ON • BOTH PHASE SWITCHES NORMAL
1. SERIES CHAIN • GND → NECK → MIDDLE → BRIDGE → BUS
Dot = connection • crossing without a dot is not connected
A500K volume • A500K tone • 22 nF • mono jack
lug numbers as in bottom view
fed from BUS, not the wiper
No treble bleed • no loading resistors • no per-pickup controls.
Shown state S10: every lever UP — all pickups ON, both phase switches NORMAL.
Chain GND → N+ → M+ → B+ → BUS. The same circuit is checked in all 32 lever states (14 distinct, incl. mute).
LEVER UP = ON (E-x) / NORMAL (P-x) • LEVER DOWN = OFF / REVERSE
ON: IN → pickup → OUT. OFF: IN joined to OUT through the enable switch; the pickup keeps one lead unconnected.
NORMAL: hot lead toward volume (x-OUT), return lead toward ground (x-Y). REVERSE swaps them.
All OFF: BUS joins GND — mute. Bridge is the fixed phase reference; it has no phase switch.
Dot = junction • crossing without a dot = not connected • arch = wire passes over
Dashed link between blades = the two ganged poles of one DPDT toggle.
Dashed box around a coil = the pickup case. The case lead is separate from the coil and goes to GND.
Switch contacts are functional, not lug numbers: identify each toggle’s lugs by continuity before wiring.
Net labels (N-Y, N-OUT, N-H, N-R, M-…, BUS, B-R, OUT, TONE-W) match reference.md §6 and the builder sheet.
Pickup lead identification (hot / return / case) comes from the supplied lead guide and a meter, not wire color alone.
Netlist check: 887 checks across 32 switch states passed when this sheet was generated.
